name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: select words in a reply and press c to cite them (a second Claude finds and checks their source), or set Citations to have Claude cite each claim you would check; a click on a citation opens its evidence. Claude draws interactive cards of the data, and v visualizes the last answer as a card. ] and [ step through a reply's citations, explainers and cards in a tray above the prompt; s rewrites a reply shorter or longer, more novice or more expert, and b catches up on several; after each reply an observer explains terms you may not know and points out important details; w lists the session's evidence; t lists the side threads asked about a citation, card or pane. Labels sort records into values, and coverage says what Claude read. Minimal makes everything on demand.

minimal.title: Minimal
minimal.description: No background tokens. Cards are enabled, while explainers, citations, heads-up, and claims only appear when you request them.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: auto cite + verify: Claude cites what each answer rests on, and a second Claude verifies each citation after each answer. auto cite: Claude cites, and a citation is verified when you open it, which spends fewer tokens. manual: select words and press c to cite them. off: no citations.

checkerModel.title: Checker
checkerModel.description: The model of the second Claude that checks citations. same as Claude: the model of the conversation. Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.1: that model, which reads the conversation without the cache of the conversation's model.

checkerEffort.title: Effort
checkerEffort.description: How hard the second Claude that checks citations thinks. same as Claude: the effort of the conversation. low, medium, high, xhigh or max: that effort, of the levels Claude Code offers for the model Checker names.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Claude draws charts and tables as cards in its answers. Press v to visualize the last answer.

squeezeAnswers.title: Rewrite
squeezeAnswers.description: Press s to rewrite an answer shorter or longer, more novice or more expert, or in your own words. Press 0 for the original. One call each time you ask.

catchUp.title: Catch-up
catchUp.description: Press b to sum up the replies that came in while you were away, in one short note. Press 0 to see the replies again. One call each time you ask.

explain.title: Explainers
explain.description: auto: terms you may not know get a short explainer after each answer, a small part of the call after it; ] opens each one. Select words and press e for one. on demand: select words and press e for a short explainer. off: no explainers.

details.title: Heads-ups
details.description: auto: details that may mislead get a heads-up after each answer, a small part of the call after it; ] opens each one. on demand: press h for heads-ups on the last answer. off: no heads-ups.

claimsMode.title: Evidence
claimsMode.description: Press w to see the conversation's claims and their evidence. auto: claims are found after each answer, the largest part of the call after it. on demand: press f in the pane to find them, which spends fewer tokens. off: no Evidence pane.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Press l to see the labels Claude made, with their values and records. No model call.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Press r to see which files Claude has read, by folder. No model call: thimble counts the files after each turn.

marks.title: Citations (old setting)

citationChecks.description: Replaced by Citations, which has its modes.

squeezeCards.description: Removed: a squeeze may move or leave out a card.
